crossRefs.note: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.
If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place…

translations.web: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.
translations.bsb: On hearing this, the crowd and city officials were greatly disturbed.
translations.kjv: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
translations.asv: And they troubled the multitude and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
